message:
The users test now passes (`npm test`: 1 pass, 0 fail).

The migration `001_create_users.js` names the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`. That mismatch caused the `unknown column users.full_name` error. I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. I didn't touch `migrations/`.

The API's public field is still `fullName`. Only the database column name changed.
